text: Where Nagas, fearful of the victorious lion, horses, burrow-dwellers, Yakshas, Kinnaras, citizens, women, and forest deities reside; where the dwellings of those whose peaks are touched by clouds are spread out, and the sounds of flutes are mingled with echoing roars; where the splendor of houses, mechanisms, and banners in the sky is created by non-human beings using only wish-fulfilling trees and swaying foliage.
